subject: Addendum to 8d3e567b: coverage we already have
body: Existing coverage on D: (GROK-HD-ENABLERS-03): eight-angle turnarounds covering front, three-quarter, profile and back. Hon is in E01, Chewy in E12 (with hands-on actions in E13), Leia in E16, the enforcer in E18 and the bounty hunter in E20. The empty-set 360s are E21-E30. So on the Hon Dolo side the gap is mostly action and partly obstructed shots, not basic angles. Lisan has no turnaround set yet and starts from scratch.
